analyzed_vuln.description: xmlParseContentInternal dereferences ctxt->input->cur via RAW/CUR/NXT macros without ensuring the current input buffer is non-empty/valid after parsing an external entity reference. In this PoV, xmlParseReference expands an external general entity (xmlParseExternalEntityPrivate), and when control returns, the parser state can leave cur positioned before a 0-length sentinel buffer; the loop condition `while ((RAW != 0) ...)` at parser.c:9957 performs a 1-byte read from `cur[-1]`/out-of-bounds global area, causing a global-buffer-overflow read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Schema harness calls xmlSchemaParse on attacker-controlled data. Input must define and reference an external entity inside content so xmlParseReference takes the external-entity path (`xmlParseExternalEntityPrivate`) and returns to xmlParseContentInternal with malformed/truncated parser state (as in the PoC). With this state, the subsequent RAW check in xmlParseContentInternal reads outside the input buffer, triggering ASan global OOB read.
